title: Bankruptcy filing - federal court process
facts: Bankruptcy cases are filed in federal bankruptcy court, not state court.
A debtor must generally provide detailed schedules and statements covering assets, debts, income, expenses, financial history and other required information.
Knowingly concealing assets or making false statements in bankruptcy can have serious civil or criminal consequences.
Bankruptcy forms, filing fees, waiver/installment rules and local court procedures should be checked against the current federal court and district requirements before filing.
